reason: I already have a drawer full of half-used supplement bottles, and I'd have to see a creator talk about a problem I actually have before I'd tap the yellow cart. Single-form magnesium doesn't jump out at me when other products pack 8 forms into one capsule.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when others put 8 forms in one capsule? Another supplement I'd probably stop taking halfway through.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing someone with my exact problem (can't wind down after the kids are asleep) using it, plus a clear reason bisglycinate alone beats the 8-form blends.
